result.summary: The page generally displays correctly, however, there is a layout issue regarding the visibility of the restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccolo' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/clipped at the end of the text label within its card.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout or text sizing to ensure the full name is visible or allow text wrapping for the title.
